organization_logic.macro_structure: problem-decomposition → network-construction → teamwork-model → regression → strategy → extension → evaluation
organization_logic.dominant_pattern: The paper follows a strict construct-then-consume architecture: each section produces exactly the indicators the next section needs as inputs. The network model feeds regression IVs; regression produces coefficients; coefficients drive strategy recommendations; recommendations map to general team cooperation.

section_coupling.coupling: individual contribution scores become regression IVs
football-specific advice maps to general teams

organization_logic.argument_quality: Strong internal consistency: every recommendation traces to a regression coefficient. Weak points: small sample acknowledged (76 data points for 13 IVs), VIF correction documented but original collinearity quite severe. The 96.1% prediction accuracy may overfit given the sample-to-variable ratio.
human_organization_signals: Nested sub-model pattern (5.1.1 through 5.1.5) mimics a Chinese academic thesis structure with fine-grained numbering
Extension section uses mechanical 'can be extended to' repetition — a human pattern of systematic analogy-mapping
Strengths-weaknesses as a separate section (common in MCM) rather than integrated into conclusion
Appendix dumps raw R and Matlab code without formatting — authentic student submission artifact

main_argument_chains.claim: A soccer team's cooperation can be modeled as a directed weighted passing network whose structural properties predict match outcomes.
support_steps: construct adjacency matrix from passing events
extract network metrics (clustering, closeness, dispersion, shortest path)
feed metrics as IVs into logistic regression
demonstrate significant coefficients for network-derived variables
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Without the network representation, the paper would lack structural indicators entirely, reducing the regression to classical football metrics only.

main_argument_chains.claim: Individual player contributions can be objectively scored by fusing AHP subjective weights with entropy-based objective weights.
support_steps: build AHP hierarchy from position-action classification
compute entropy weights from data dispersion
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Without the AHP-entropy fusion, individual contribution would be measured by raw action counts, losing the position-specific weighting that captures role differences.

main_argument_chains.claim: Formation effectiveness is conditional on opponent strategy, not absolute.
support_steps: split 76 matches into 3 subgroups by opponent formation
show defensive formation significant only against balanced opponents (Table7)
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Without the heterogeneity analysis, the paper would claim formation effects are universal, missing the opponent-conditional interaction that makes recommendations actionable.

main_argument_chains.claim: Football team cooperation findings generalize to any team-based organization.
support_steps: map passing flexibility to communication coverage
map clustering coefficient to communication frequency
repeat 'can be extended to' pattern 7+ times
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Without the extension mapping, the paper would be a pure sports analytics exercise; the generalization argument elevates it to a team cooperation framework.

warnings.warning: Last-pass warning: Claims 'R2 is close to 1' for logistic regression. Pseudo-R² values close to 1 are extremely rare in logistic regression and strongly suggest overfitting, especially with 76 observations and 13 IVs. T

Last-pass warning: Claims 96.1% prediction accuracy (73/76 correct). With 76 observations used for both training and testing, this is likely in-sample accuracy, not cross-validated. No train-test split or k-fold CV ment

Last-pass warning: 'the model has serious multicollinearity' acknowledged, then corrected via stepwise regression. However, stepwise regression in small samples is known to produce unstable variable selection. No bootst

Last-pass warning: Heterogeneity analysis splits 76 observations into 3 subgroups by opponent formation. With ~25 observations per subgroup and 10+ variables, subgroup regressions are severely underpowered. No adjustmen
